# Wepho — full content export

> Wepho is a Custom Wedding Experience Studio that designs and builds one-night-only interactive web apps for individual wedding couples. Guests use the app on their phones during the reception — trivia about how the couple met, live prediction vaults, video guestbooks, custom scavenger hunts. Each app is bespoke to one wedding, hosted for that single night, and priced at roughly $2,000.

This file mirrors the linked essay and page content on wepho.com in a single plain-text document, following the emerging llms-full.txt convention. For the concise route index, see /llms.txt.

## What Wepho is

Wepho builds one custom web app per wedding. Not a template. Not a shared photo feed. A game or experience designed around one couple's specific story, in-jokes, and guest list — hosted live during the reception on guests' own phones, then archived for the couple.

- Price: roughly $2,000 per custom app.
- Timeline: 4–8 weeks from discovery call to delivery.
- Model: contact form → discovery call → custom build → live on the wedding night → keepsake artifact delivered after.
- Audience: engaged couples, and the wedding planners who serve them.
- Differentiator: bespoke. The one rule of the studio: specificity creates believability. Never a trivia game "about your relationship" — a trivia game whose every question is about how you actually met, who proposed first, and what she said when he did.

The site itself sells the service and books consultations. Two homepage demos let visitors experience the format without seeing a real wedding's content:
- Love Letter Machine — visitor types a message, approves it, sees it revealed on a simulated big-screen frame.
- Who Said It? — guess which half of the couple said each quote.

## Custom app catalog

Each app has its own marketing page at /apps/[slug].

### Live "How Well Do You Know Us?" Trivia
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/couple-trivia

A live multiplayer quiz played by the whole room at once — a host reads each question aloud, the same question hits every guest's phone at the same moment, and a shared leaderboard climbs on the reception screen. Every question is about the couple's real relationship.

### Venue Scavenger Hunt with Their Love Story
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/venue-scavenger-hunt

QR codes hidden around the venue each unlock a chapter of the couple's love story — cocktail hour becomes a treasure hunt through their actual lives.

### Anniversary Time Capsule
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/anniversary-time-capsule

Guests record short video messages sealed until the 1st, 5th, or 10th anniversary — the app locks them and delivers them automatically on the right date.

### The Prediction Vault
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/prediction-vault

Guests submit sealed predictions about the couple's future grouped by year (1, 5, 10, 25 years out), unlocked on each anniversary when the couple scores them.

### The Couple's Unpopular Opinions Icebreaker
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/unpopular-opinions

The couple pre-loads their real unpopular opinions and guests vote agree/disagree in real time, revealing whether the room sides with the bride or groom on each take.

### Custom Wedding Bingo
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/wedding-bingo

Every guest gets a unique bingo card with custom squares the couple wrote — 'best man trips on his speech,' 'DJ plays ABBA' — and taps them as they happen in real time.

### The Guest Advice Oracle
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/advice-oracle

Guests respond to structured prompts — best marriage advice, a mistake to avoid, something you wish someone had told you — displayed as a live scrolling oracle wall.

### Where To Next
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/where-next-map

Guests pin places on an interactive world map — the couple's meaningful spots, neighborhoods they should move to, restaurants they must try, cities they should retire in — filling live on the reception display.

### Who Said It?
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/who-said-it

A live guessing game: real texts and photos from your relationship, blurred sender, guests vote his side vs her side vs mutual friends.

### The Story Chain
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/story-chain

A collaborative story that grows one guest-written sentence at a time on the big screen, starting from a single prompt about how the couple's love actually began.

### Ask Us Anything
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/ask-us-anything

Guests submit and upvote questions for the couple during dinner — silly to sincere — and the couple answers the top ten live at the mic over dessert.

### The Two-Minute Video Guestbook
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/video-guestbook

Instead of signing a book, guests record a short video message from their seat — every clip curated into a film delivered the week after the wedding.

### The Home Your Room Built
URL: https://wepho.com/apps/home-the-room-built

Guests fill your someday home from their phones — a dog, a big table, a herb garden, a record player, one silly rule — and a composite illustration of the house draws itself live on the reception screen. You leave with a framed poster of the home your people imagined for you.

## For wedding planners
URL: https://wepho.com/planners

Planners partner with Wepho to offer custom apps as an upsell or signature touch for their couples. The planner briefs Wepho on the couple; Wepho handles the build, hosting, and night-of technical operation. Revenue share or referral options depending on volume.

## Moodboard quiz
URL: https://wepho.com/moodboard

A short guided quiz that maps a couple's vibe, guests, moments, feelings, story, and one wildcard into a recommended shortlist of custom app types. Output is a brief the couple can share with Wepho as the starting point for a discovery call.

## Essays

The Wepho blog collects long-form essays on wedding reception design — reception ideas, activities, speeches, guestbooks, venues, and the design principles behind Wepho apps. Many essays are currently in draft; the entries below show each essay's angle and outline so a reader can understand what the finished piece will cover.

## Contact

Primary booking channel: contact form on the homepage (https://wepho.com/#contact) posting to /api/contact. Couples and planners submit wedding date, venue, and what they're imagining. Wepho responds within 1–2 business days to schedule a discovery call.
